notes: Layout 3D: red X, green Y and blue Z axes (Axes button). While dragging pieces, tap X, Y or Z to keep the move on that axis. Right-click > Move… for an exact X, Y, Z. Align faces: click the face that stays, then the face to move; its whole 3D group slides onto that plane. R rotates the selected pieces on X, Y or Z by any angle (90 by default).
